children: Effective November 23, 2026, Richard McPhail becomes CEO, Ann-Marie Campbell becomes president and COO, and Jordan Broggi becomes EVP and CFO. Ted Decker steps down as president and CEO and remains chair.
A CEO transition can alter investor expectations for strategy and execution; McPhail previously served as EVP and CFO.
Campbell named president and COO, effective Nov. 23
The expanded operational leadership role places a long-tenured executive over additional functions, including supply chain and online.
Broggi appointed EVP and CFO, effective Nov. 23
A new CFO takes responsibility for financial operations and strategic financial functions; no financial targets were announced.
Decker steps down as CEO; remains board chair
The outgoing CEO remains in a senior board role, providing continuity while executive responsibilities change.

This is a planned leadership transition involving three senior appointments and the outgoing CEO's continuation as chair. Investors will look for subsequent disclosures on strategy, financial priorities, or execution under the new leadership team.
